title: Molecular insights into aggregate speciation of diglycolamides for efficient extraction of rare earth elements
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33006-33017
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03801D, Paper

Surfactant based extraction optimization is governed by physicochemical phenomena occurring across multiple length scales. Effective control of aggregate speciation at the nanoscale has implications for enhancing macroscale separation efficiency.
